_comment: Generated by mods-src/seraphhorizons/ParkesKettle/tools/make_shape.py. Native frame, block units, controller cell at [0,0,0]: the front middle cell at ground level, the fire's front. The kettle, centred left to right in the front two rows, hangs by its flange flush with the floor, worked from its top (kettleCell, mouth: lead and zinc in, the crust skimmed and the lead ladled out, by hand); kettles stand side by side in a row along x (up to furnace.rowMax), sharing one chimney on one member's outlet, the others capped. Natural draught, in at the ash mouth (ash, ashSide) under the damper; fuel by hand at the fire door (fireDoor, fireDoorSide). The axle comes in at powerCell's south face, at the gallows' height: theta turns the drive shaft and its pinion about z (ratio 1) and the stirrer about y (ratio 1) through a mitre pair; flat paddles stir alike either way, so nothing reads the shaft's travel. depth is the fire door: 0 shut (the rest pose), 1 open, lifted in its guides. requires: the build's stages, brickwork, lining, kettle (with the fire door and the damper) and stirrer (with the gallows and the drive) (build; the frame, iron, has none); the bath's four levels, lead1..lead4 (a quarter of a charge each, by volume); zinc, crust; the coal's two layers fuel1..2 and the same burning, fire1..2; the damper's place, damperopen, damperhalf or dampershut (one at a time); and outletcap. outletCell: the stack in the back row's east corner, the chimney stood on its top; chimney: the shortest chimney, counted from the outlet up. See ParkesKettle/README.md.

build._comment: The build's stages, in order (provisional: the owner settles them, #928). frame: the iron frame's grid recipe (with a hammer); placing it puts down the controller and its ghosts, and draws the frame part. Each stage then fits its requires when its materials are all in: brickwork, then lining, measured from the model (volumeBlocks) at 2 fired bricks or 4 refractory bricks a block, rounded up, fire clay one per 2.5 refractory bricks; perClick stack: a click puts in as many of the held stack as are still needed; oneType: the first fired brick sets the setting's type (bricks). kettle: the cast-iron kettle set in its seat, and with it (alsoParts) the fire door and (also) the damper's places. stirrer: the stirrer, and with it the gallows and the drive. The kettle's contents, the fire and the damper are drawn once the kettle stage is in, the cap once the lining is.

bricks._comment: The fired brick types the brickwork takes (every game:burnedbrick type), each with the block its bricks make and that block's texture: the renderer sets the shape's 'brick' code to the setting's type's base, with its overlays drawn over it. The setting's type is the first brick put in; until then no brick is drawn. A type missing here (another mod's) is refused.

furnace._comment: chargeUnits: what the kettle drawn full holds (#927's charge); leadLevels: the bath is drawn as lead1.. up to ceil(fill x leadLevels), each a quarter of a charge by volume; fuelLayers, fuelPerLayer: the grate's coal is drawn as its layers fuel1.. up to ceil(coal / fuelPerLayer) (fire.. while lit), the grate holding fuelLayers x fuelPerLayer; coalPerCharge: the coal a charge burns (#927); minChimney: chimney blocks stood on the outlet, counted from it up; rowMax, rowAxis: kettles in a row, side by side along x, sharing one chimney; stirRatio: the stirrer's turns a turn of the axle (the mitre pair); fireDoorLift: how far the fire door lifts open (blocks).
